# PDF validator acceptance corpus

This directory contains small, repository-owned synthetic PDFs used to protect
the PDF package validator's structural and safety contract. No fixture was made
from a customer, council, project, standards publication, or other third-party
document.

`manifest.json` is authoritative. It records a stable fixture ID, provenance,
license, intended mechanism or hazard, expected findings and artifact outcomes,
byte length, and SHA-256 digest for every distributed PDF. The corpus-hygiene
test rejects an unlisted file or stale digest.

Regenerate the corpus with:

```bash
uv run --extra pdf python validator_backends/pdf/tests/fixtures/generate.py
```

The generator uses pikepdf/qpdf only as a structural writer. It fixes document
IDs and omits source timestamps for ordinary fixtures. Encryption necessarily
contains cryptographic material generated by qpdf; those two outputs are kept
small and are pinned by the manifest rather than claimed to be reproducible
across qpdf releases. Regeneration is therefore an intentional reviewed update,
never a test-suite side effect.

The hostile files are structurally small. Limit and decompression behavior is
exercised with deliberately low test configuration or short filter chains; no
fixture is intended to consume dangerous resources merely by being opened.
